title: Blender MCP Connect instance descriptor
description: Runtime descriptor written by the Blender MCP Connect extension and read by the external MCP server for automatic instance discovery.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this descriptor file format. Bump on breaking descriptor changes.

protocolVersion.description: Version of the bridge wire protocol (NUL-delimited JSON over TCP). Must match the MCP server's supported version.

instanceId.description: UUIDv4 identifying this Blender process instance. Stable for the lifetime of the Blender process.

pid.description: Hint only; PID reuse means this is never authoritative. Verified via authenticated hello handshake.

host.description: Bridge bind host. Automatic mode always uses 127.0.0.1.

port.description: Actual OS-assigned bridge port. Never 0 in a published descriptor.

token.description: Random capability token. Never logged or displayed. Verified with constant-time comparison before any code execution.

blenderExecutable.description: Absolute path to the running Blender executable. Used for _for_cli tools when BLENDER_PATH is unset.

blendFile.description: Absolute path of the currently open .blend file, or empty string when none.

startedAt.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the bridge started.

updatedAt.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the last metadata refresh.
